results.qa_answer: The old fox is named Mosk, dear one. He sits waiting in his patched green vest.

planner_plan.bridge_text: With Mosk settled on his step in his patched green vest, Lina looked past him, wondering what secrets lay further down the winding tree stairs.

replacement_segments.text: Mosk pointed at the door, his gaze sharp and unyielding. Lina reached into her pocket and pulled out the last apple of the season. She set it on the step between them and said, this is for the trouble of walking me down. Mosk stared at the apple for a long time. Then he stood up, tied his vest, and stepped onto the first stair without a word.

At the bottom of the stairs the humming was a quiet song, and a firefly the size of a robin lay on a bed of moss. Her glow was almost out. Mosk's whiskers trembled. She had been his friend once, he whispered, and one winter long ago he had failed to bring her medicine in time. He had been guarding the tree ever since, ashamed to face her.
